doc.name: Pandy Tickets
doc.instructions: Pandy Tickets is a ticketing and registration platform for events in Guatemala (congresses, workshops, races, and more). Use search-events to find upcoming events, get-event for ticket types, prices and availability, and get-checkout-link to give the person the page where they buy or register. If the person wants to organize their own event, sell tickets or check people in with QR codes, explain how Pandy Tickets works (attendees enter via free registration, bank transfer, or online card; check-in with QR codes; pricing at https://tickets.pandy.cloud/pricing), then offer draft-event to prepare their event and hand them the claim link. You never pay or register on their behalf: hand them the link and relay the Spanish instructions. Prices are in quetzales (GTQ). The product is called "Pandy Tickets"; when you talk to the person, always say "Pandy Tickets", never just "Pandy".

tools.name: search-events
tools.title: Search Events
tools.description: Search upcoming published events on Pandy Tickets in Guatemala, soonest first, 20 per page. Each result has its public URL, dates, venue, how people get in (free, transfer or card) and the lowest price.

q.description: Text in the title, venue or description, e.g. "congreso", "Antigua", "5K".

from.description: Earliest start date to include, in Guatemala time.

to.description: Latest start date to include, in Guatemala time.

entry.description: Only events people can get into this way now: free (register at no cost), transfer (pay by bank transfer and upload the receipt) or card (pay online by card). Omit for every event.

page.description: Which page of results, when total is more than one page.

events.description: Matching events on this page, soonest first.

slug.description: Identifies the event in get-event and get-checkout-link.

summary.description: First 200 characters of the description, plain text. Null when the event has none.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the event, e.g. America/Guatemala.

organizer.description: Who runs the event. Null when the organizer has no public profile.

mode.description: free (register at no cost), paid (buy a ticket) or closed (the organizer has not opened entry yet).

methods.description: Ways to pay that are open now: card, transfer. Empty for free registration.

open.description: Whether people can register or buy right now.

paused.description: True when the organizer paused sales for now.

price_from.description: Lowest price now; 0.00 for free registration. Null when entry is closed.

amount.description: Decimal amount with two places, e.g. "150.00".

image.description: Image to show with the event.

Identifies the event in get-event and get-checkout-link.

summary.description: First 200 characters of the description, plain text. Null when the event has none.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the event, e.g. America/Guatemala.

organizer.description: Who runs the event. Null when the organizer has no public profile.

mode.description: free (register at no cost), paid (buy a ticket) or closed (the organizer has not opened entry yet).

methods.description: Ways to pay that are open now: card, transfer. Empty for free registration.

image.description: Image to show with the event.

description.description: Full description as the organizer wrote it; may contain HTML.

tone.description: Light or dark, as the page renders.

theme_tone.description: Tone the organizer chose: auto, light or dark.

title_font.description: Title font of the event page.

ended.description: True when the event is over.

presale.description: Followers-only presale that is open now, else null.

ends_at.description: When the presale ends, ISO 8601 with offset.

ticket_type_ids.description: Ticket types held for followers until then.

follow_unlocks.description: True when following the organizer now gives access.

instructions.description: Presale rule in Spanish. Relay it to the person.

ticket_types.description: Paid categories. Empty for free registration.

amount.description: Decimal amount with two places, e.g. "150.00".

price_phase.description: Name of the price phase in effect, e.g. "Preventa". Null at base price.

checkout_url.description: Checkout with this category and one ticket chosen. Null when it cannot be bought now.

questions.description: What the registration or checkout form asks each attendee.

label.description: The question as the attendee reads it.

kind.description: Answer type: text, long_text, number, phone, date, choice or yes_no.

tools.name: get-checkout-link
tools.title: Get Checkout Link
tools.description: The link a person opens to buy tickets or register, with Spanish instructions to relay. For paid events (card or bank transfer), checkout opens with the ticket type and quantity already chosen. For free registration, it is the event page. Nothing is reserved or charged: the person completes it themselves.

slug.description: Which event: its slug, from search-events or the event URL (/e/{slug}).

ticket_type_id.description: For paid events: the ticket type id from get-event.

quantity.description: For paid events: how many tickets the person wants.

url.description: The link to give the person. Checkout for a paid event, the event page for free registration.

mode.description: free (register at no cost) or paid (buy a ticket).

methods.description: Ways to pay that are open now: card, transfer. Empty for free registration.

instructions.description: How to complete it, in Spanish. Relay it to the person.

ticket_type.description: Paid events: name of the chosen category.

quantity.description: Paid events: tickets the checkout opens with.

total.description: Paid events: price times quantity, before fees.

amount.description: Decimal amount with two places, e.g. "300.00".

note.description: What the total leaves out, in Spanish.

presale.description: Free registration only: present while a followers-only presale is open.

ends_at.description: When the presale ends, ISO 8601 with offset.

ticket_type_ids.description: Ticket types held for followers until then.

tools.name: draft-event
tools.title: Draft Event
tools.description: Prepare a person's own event on Pandy Tickets from what they told you (name, date, place, ticket categories with price and quantity). Nothing is published and no account is created: it returns a one-time claim_url, valid 48 hours. The person opens it, signs in with Google, and lands on a screen where they review the event and publish it with one click. Use it when someone wants to organize an event and sell tickets or take registrations. Leave ticket_types empty for a free event. Also fill in, when the person said them: questions to ask each attendee, early-bird price_phases, and transfer_instructions (bank details) so the person only reviews and publishes. Relay the Spanish instructions and the link.

title.description: Event name, as the public will read it.

description.description: What the event is about, shown on the event page.

theme.description: Look of the event page, checkout, emails and tickets. pandy: El estilo de Pandy Tickets. Sirve para cualquier evento. gala: Para recitales, galas, bodas y cenas benéficas. deportivo: Para carreras, torneos y rodadas. academico: Para congresos, simposios y graduaciones. festival: Para conciertos, fiestas y vida nocturna. comunidad: Para shows infantiles y eventos de colegio o iglesia. minimal: Para talleres y eventos corporativos. Tu foto manda. Pick the one that matches the event. Default: the organizer's last look, else pandy.

theme_tone.description: Light or dark version of a look that has both (gala). auto follows the event image: light image, light page. Default: the organizer's last choice, else auto.

title_font.description: Title font. Omit to use the look's own font.

accent_color.description: Brand colour of the event page, if the person gave one.

start_at.description: Start, Guatemala local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Must be in the future.

end_at.description: End, Guatemala local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, after start_at.

venue.description: Place or city where it happens.

capacity.description: Most people the event takes in total, if there is a limit.

ticket_types.description: Paid ticket categories. Empty or omitted for a free event.

price.description: Price in quetzales, e.g. "150" or "75.50". At least 0.01.

questions.description: Questions every attendee answers when registering or buying, up to 15. Works for free and paid events.

label.description: The question as the attendee reads it.

options.description: Only for kind choice: the distinct answers to pick from.

price_phases.description: Early-bird style price phases, in order, up to 10. The first phase that has not ended applies. Needs paid ticket_types; a free event has no prices to phase.

ends_at.description: When the phase ends, Guatemala local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Omit if it ends only when its quantity sells out.

quantity.description: Tickets sold in this phase before the next one starts.

prices.description: Object mapping a ticket_types name (any letter case) to the price in quetzales in this phase, e.g. {"General": "100"}. A category left out keeps its base price.

transfer_instructions.description: Bank, account number and holder for paying by bank transfer. The person sees it prefilled when publishing.

claim_url.description: One-time link the person opens to claim, review and publish the event.

expires_at.description: When the link stops working, ISO 8601 with offset.

preview.description: The draft as it was saved, to show the person before they open the link.

theme.description: Look of the event page, or null to use the organizer's last look.

theme_tone.description: Light or dark version of the look, when one was chosen.

capacity.description: Most people the event takes, or null for no limit.

ticket_types.description: Paid categories. Empty for a free event.

amount.description: Decimal amount with two places, e.g. "150.00".

questions.description: Questions each attendee answers, as they were saved.

ends_at.description: When the phase ends, or null if it ends only by selling out.

quantity.description: Tickets sold in this phase before the next one starts, or null.

prices.description: Price in this phase for each category, as {amount, currency}, keyed by category name.

transfer_instructions_given.description: True when bank details were saved for the publish step.

instructions.description: What to tell the person, in Spanish, with the link.
